item.tib: phyag mchod kyi rim pa sgyu skar rgyan gyi phreng ba
item.coloph: ces gsang yum rnams kyi bstod pa rdzogs so / gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs bsgrubs shing grub pa mnga' bsnyems pa'i / gsang ba'i grub chen brgyad cu'i mdzad phrin mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i rlabs / gsang bdag dmu dbang chen po'i bshad byang rgyu skar 'phreng ba 'di / gsang sngags rjes 'jug sgrub smon dad ldan bdag gis bzhengs / 'di bzhengs dge rtsa mkha' khyab sems can yongs la bsngo
item.note: the main text contained here has been written by two different authors. the first part, by dmu-gshen nyi-ma rgyal-mtshan, is a ritual of worship of the early siddhas of the mother tantra (pp. 527-570, line 2). the author of the second part of the work is unknown; this text is for the worship of later siddhas (pp. 585-586). the two colophons are given separately as above. p. 585 (marginal title: mchod tshig), contains words of worship to be repeated after praising each siddha. p. 586 is an added worship text of rnga-ba dpon-slob yon-tan rgya-mtsho, written by tshe-dbang 'gyur-med (see p. 586, line 3: zhes rnga ba'i grwa btsun rgyal mtshan sogs grwa gnyis bskul ngor tshe dbang 'gyur med pas gsol ba btab pa'o).
